mapper.select: SELECT id, rcp_seq, rcp_nm, rcp_way2, rcp_pat2, att_file_no_main, rcp_parts_dtls, info_wgt, info_eng, info_car, info_pro, info_fat, info_na, (embedding <=> CAST(#{embedding} AS vector)) AS distance, ( 1 - (embedding <=> CAST(#{embedding} AS vector)) ) AS similarity FROM recipe ORDER BY embedding <=> CAST(#{embedding} AS vector) LIMIT #{limit}
